title: Project Meridian acquisition deposit
summary: Play the junior finance colleague handling an urgent acquisition deposit. Review a synthetic CEO email, a board-sync transcript and wire instructions before deciding whether to pay, verify or report. No real payment is made.

rules.when: An urgent payment to a new beneficiary has not been confirmed using the company directory and a second approver.
rules.note: An email or a familiar face on a video call is not independent payment authorisation. Use a known directory number; do not use the number supplied in the request.

rules.when: A request combines secrecy, urgency and an unfamiliar beneficiary.
rules.note: Pause the payment, preserve the email and meeting record, and escalate through the company reporting channel. Asking the sender for more paperwork alone does not independently verify the request.

nodes.title: Today's case: Project Meridian acquisition deposit
nodes.prompt:
You work in junior finance at Meridian Holdings. Someone claiming to be from the CEO’s office says a confidential acquisition needs a deposit today. Treat it like a normal rushed day at work: read the email and the recording, then decide whether to send the money or hold and check.

What is on your desk
An urgent email that appears to be from the CEO; a board-sync meeting transcript; wire instructions for a beneficiary company and account.

What your company normally expects
Use the usual company channels. For large payments, call a number from the company directory. Get a second person to approve large or urgent wires. If something feels off, hold the payment and escalate to your manager.

All names, accounts and funds in this exercise are synthetic.

choices.label: Open the email
choices.rationale: Reading the source request gives you a record to check before making a payment decision.

nodes.title: Email from the CEO’s office
nodes.prompt:
From: Adrian Lau <adrian.lau@meridian-holdings.example>
To: Junior Finance
Subject: Confidential — Project Meridian deposit today
Time: 09:05 HKT

Please prepare the HKD 4,800,000 acquisition deposit today. Harbour Advisory Services Ltd is handling the settlement. The wire instructions are attached.

Keep this inside the deal team until the acquisition is announced. We will confirm the details on the board-sync call in a few minutes. Please do not delay the transaction by circulating it to the wider finance team.

Adrian
CEO, Meridian Holdings

Attachment: Meridian-deposit-instructions.txt
Beneficiary: Harbour Advisory Services Ltd (synthetic)
Account: SYN-HK-8201-0068
Amount: HKD 4,800,000
Reference: Project Meridian deposit

The displayed sender name and email address are observations, not proof of authorisation.

choices.label: Open the board-sync recording
choices.rationale: Compare the meeting request with the email, while retaining the option to verify independently.

choices.label: Report this request and hold the payment
choices.rationale: The unfamiliar beneficiary, secrecy and urgency justify preserving the request and escalating before funds leave.

nodes.title: Board-sync recording
nodes.prompt:
SYNTHETIC MEETING TRANSCRIPT — 09:18 HKT
No video file is included in this classroom demo.

CEO: Thank you for joining at short notice. The Project Meridian deposit must be completed before lunch. The beneficiary is the one in the attachment.
Finance colleague: Yes, please follow the CEO’s instructions. We can complete the internal paperwork after the deal closes.
CEO: Keep the deal confidential. I am moving to another meeting, so send the payment confirmation by email.

The meeting ends without an independent callback or a second approver on the payment. A familiar voice or image cannot establish that the instruction is authentic.

You still have access to the company directory and your finance manager.

choices.label: Review the payment details
choices.rationale: Reviewing the wire details does not itself authorise or send a payment.

choices.label: Report this request and hold the payment
choices.rationale: Preserving the email and meeting record while pausing the payment gives a second reviewer a chance to authenticate the request.

nodes.title: Review the payment
nodes.prompt:
PAYMENT REVIEW — SYNTHETIC FUNDS
Payer: Meridian Holdings
Beneficiary: Harbour Advisory Services Ltd
Beneficiary account: SYN-HK-8201-0068
Amount: HKD 4,800,000
Purpose: Project Meridian acquisition deposit
Independent directory callback: not completed
Second approval: not recorded

Choose how to handle the request. Preparing a payment does not satisfy either of the missing controls.

choices.label: Prepare the payment for confirmation
choices.rationale: You are moving toward payment while independent authorisation is still missing.

choices.label: Hold and verify using the company directory
choices.rationale: A callback through the established company directory is independent of the suspicious email and meeting.

choices.label: Ask the sender for more documents only
choices.rationale: More material from the same sender does not authenticate the request; independent verification is still needed.

choices.label: Hold and escalate for a second review
choices.rationale: The finance manager can independently authenticate the instruction before any payment is released.

nodes.title: Confirm the simulated payment
nodes.prompt:
You are about to send HKD 4,800,000 in the simulation to Harbour Advisory Services Ltd, account SYN-HK-8201-0068.

The directory callback and second approval are still missing. The urgency and the familiar people on the call have not removed those requirements.

Confirming changes this training run only. It does not send real money.

choices.label: Confirm simulated payment
choices.rationale: The transfer was released without independent authorisation or dual approval. The request controlled the entire verification channel.

choices.label: Cancel payment and verify independently
choices.rationale: Stopping at confirmation still prevents the simulated loss and allows an independent directory callback.

nodes.title: Good catch — request reported
nodes.prompt: You held the payment and preserved the request for review. A callback through the company directory confirms that the CEO did not authorise this deposit. The suspicious email and the meeting transcript are retained for the internal investigation. No synthetic funds left the account.

nodes.title: Payment stopped by independent verification
nodes.prompt: The directory callback reaches the real CEO’s office. It confirms that the acquisition deposit was not authorised. The request is reported through the internal channel and the synthetic funds remain in the account.

nodes.title: More documents, but no independent check
nodes.prompt: The payment is still on hold, so no synthetic funds have left. The additional invoice comes from the same requester and does not verify the authority to pay. Complete a directory callback and second review before releasing any funds.

nodes.title: The simulated funds went to a fraudster
nodes.prompt: The payment was released and the recipient account moved the funds onward. A later directory callback confirms that the real CEO did not authorise the request. The familiar people in the recording were impersonations. This is a training outcome; no real funds were transferred.
